sanskrit: putro jātastu duḥśīlo devabrāhmaṇavaṃcakaḥ | kurūpaḥ karkaśo duṣṭaḥ prakṛtyā pāpapūruṣaḥ || 24 || atha dīrgheṇa kālena dvādaśābdaṃ bhayāvahā | anāvṛṣṭistu saṃjātā sarvaprāṇibhayaṃkarī || 25 || viyogastu tvayā prāpto mayā sārddhaṃ sutena ca | tato'haṃ duḥkhasaṃtapto vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 26 ||
english: “I was a base Śūdra always despising and decrying the Vedas. I committed breach of trust always and you too were likewise. A son was born to us. He was habitually of bad character and used to deceive Brāhmaṇas and Devas. Ugly and rough, the wicked fellow had the innate qualities of a sinful person. Then there was a terrible protracted drought lasting for twelve years. It terrified all living beings. I was separated from you as well as from the son. That made me distressed through misery. I was disgusted to the utmost.
